fluff.overview: Anti-BattleMech foot squads are squad-strength formations trained in close-assault tactics against armored combat vehicles. Smaller than a full anti-BattleMech platoon, these squads rely on stealth, ambush positioning, and terrain advantage to close with targets that outmass them by orders of magnitude. Their reduced numbers make each engagement a high-risk commitment, but in restrictive terrain where a single BattleMech can be isolated, even a squad of trained anti-BattleMech infantry poses a credible threat to leg actuators, sensor arrays, and exposed weapon housings.
